title: Introduction to Honors
description: Ways to integrate learning and experiences to enrich college experience. Leadership, community service, research and creative arts, scholarship and fellowships, and study abroad opportunities.

title: Seminar in Honors Connection and Commitment
description: Interdisciplinary education and the theoretical and practical integration of knowledge. Coursework beyond the classroom in areas of community service, creative activity, leadership, research, and study abroad.

title: Special Study
notes: A maximum combined credit of nine units of 299, 499 courses applicable to a bachelor’s degree.

title: Seminar in Interdisciplinary Studies
description: Idea, philosophy, and method of interdisciplinary studies. Various disciplines and topics from interdisciplinary perspectives, workplaces, and societal settings. Integration of a variety of schools of thought and the value of an interdisciplinary outlook.

title: Interdisciplinary Perspectives on Social Problems
description: Various social problems from interdisciplinary perspectives.

title: Seminar in Integrative Capstone
description: Honors culminating capstone experience. Synthesis and integration of academic, professional, and community involvement, including major and honors-specific coursework and high impact practices. Formulation of action plan for post-baccalaureate personal and professional aspirations.

title: Special Study
notes: A maximum combined credit of nine units of 299, 499 courses applicable to a bachelor’s degree. Maximum credit of six units of 499 applicable to a bachelor’s degree.
